description: Talavera Orbital is a team from Puebla, Mexico, led by Salvador Martínez Ayala, a Systems & IT Engineering student. I build end to end: Python data pipelines, Node.js/JavaScript web apps and simulations grounded in real NASA open data. Focus: rigorous analysis, clear visualizations and strong storytelling. Looking for teammates in Earth/space science, data visualization, UI/graphic design or video who want to aim for a Global Award. Español / English.
